name: @ai-stylist/contracts
description: Canonical API + event contracts: OpenAPI 3.1 per module, JSON Schema 2020-12 events, and the generated TypeScript outputs (planning/06 §1).

scripts.lint:openapi: redocly bundle openapi/openapi.yaml --ext json --output node_modules/.cache/openapi.lint.json >/dev/null && spectral lint --fail-severity=warn --ruleset ../../.spectral.yaml node_modules/.cache/openapi.lint.json && if [ -n "${OASDIFF_BASE:-}" ]; then oasdiff breaking --fail-on WARN "$OASDIFF_BASE" node_modules/.cache/openapi.lint.json; else echo 'oasdiff: OASDIFF_BASE not set, skipping breaking-change check'; fi
